io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.guide.widgets

Class GuideWidgetRegistry

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.guide.widgets.GuideWidgetRegistry

  • public final class GuideWidgetRegistry
extends java.lang.Object
    The set of GuideWidgets for one server boot. Empty by default (core registers none); addons register their functional guide screens in onEnable. Not thread-safe: touched only on the main thread (setup + guide opens).

        @Nonnull
public java.util.List<GuideWidget> getForCategory(@Nonnull
                                                           java.lang.String categoryId)
        The addon widgets that declared this category, shown alongside it in the categorized layout.
        Implementation Note:
        Main-menu widgets are excluded: they already have their own place on the main menu in both layouts, so including them here would show them twice.
